widgets.title: Active Runs
widgets.render:
() => <KpiTile icon="fa-layer-group" tone="teal" label="Active Runs" value={kk?.activeRuns ?? 0} sub="In the reporting window" loading={kpiLoading}
        link={{ label: 'View runs', onClick: () => focusRegister('all') }} />

widgets.title: Employees Due
widgets.render:
() => <KpiTile icon="fa-users" tone="blue" label="Employees Due" value={kk?.employeesDue ?? 0} sub="Current calc population" loading={kpiLoading}
        link={{ label: 'View runs', onClick: () => focusRegister('all') }} />

widgets.title: Gross Payroll
widgets.render:
() => <KpiTile icon="fa-coins" tone="green" label="Gross Payroll" value={kk ? fmtTTDc(kk.grossPayroll.amount) : '—'} sub="Window total" loading={kpiLoading}
        link={{ label: 'View runs', onClick: () => focusRegister('all') }} />

widgets.title: Net Payroll
widgets.render:
() => <KpiTile icon="fa-wallet" tone="teal" label="Net Payroll" value={kk ? fmtTTDc(kk.netPayroll.amount) : '—'} sub="Window total" loading={kpiLoading}
        link={{ label: 'View runs', onClick: () => focusRegister('all') }} />
